clinicalReview: Required before activation in Epic. Not the standard of care.
title: Ketamine Subanesthetic Intravenous Infusions for Analgesia
mission: At order time, check whether a subanesthetic ketamine infusion for analgesia is inside this standard.
checkpoints: Require age over 3 years, a patient who is not intubated, and pain that has not resolved on opioids or has a poor opioid side-effect profile.
Stop for ketamine allergy, liver failure, myocardial ischemia, schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder, bipolar mania, intubation, age 3 years or under, and pregnancy.
Infusion instructions are quoted from the PDF and stay unsigned until the clinician signs them.
mayPropose: An unsigned MedicationRequest for the infusion the summary specifies, or a card that the draft order is outside the summary.
cardSummary: TCH subanesthetic ketamine standard may apply. Check age, airway, and the exclusion list.
